Commerce Trust Company is a $90.0B in assets wealth & advisory firm regulated by Federal Reserve / OCC (bank & trust). A 5.5% multi-year growth rate and a trajectory the analyst classifies as accelerating give it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-010, E-023]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.8/5. The deepest capability gap is Digital Identity Verification (IDV) at 2.3/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-031, E-034]. Next is Recommendations & Decisioning at 2.5/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-038, E-037].

Third is GenAI Content Generation at 2.6/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-030, E-032]. Closing Digital Identity Verification (IDV) to the peer median alone is worth 0.7 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.
